comments.author: giardini
comments.story: What happens to developers who never go into management?
comments.text: Article is far too optimistic. They get laid off before reaching retirement or vesting their pension and are replaced by younger and less expensive workers. They live in a van by the river and take such odd jobs as"motivational speaker": [VIDEO]
